book.title: 萤火虫为什么会发光
book.subtitle: 小小腹部里的冷光信号
book.question: 萤火虫为什么会发光？

moral.zh: 萤火虫发光器里的荧光素在荧光素酶、氧气等参与下发生反应，把大部分能量变成光，常用闪光与同类交流、寻找伴侣。
moral.en: A reaction involving luciferin, luciferase and oxygen makes fireflies’ cool light, often used to communicate with other fireflies.

pages.enText: On a summer night, Xiaoyu sits beside a meadow with Mother. Fireflies blink in the grass. “Why do fireflies glow?”

pages.enText: A firefly’s abdomen has a special light organ containing luciferin and luciferase.

pages.enText: This is called bioluminescence. Different firefly species use different flashing rhythms to communicate and find mates.
